HouseCarl._comment: Local-dev config. Mo2InstanceDir = the MO2 instance folder (the one containing ModOrganizer.ini); houseCARL reads it to DERIVE ProfileDir/ModsDir/DataDir + the active profile (§8.5: TRUE active order read statically from the profile's loadorder.txt + modlist.txt + plugins.txt — no USVFS, no live MO2 state). The PRODUCT sets this via housecarl_set_mo2_instance (saved to houseCARL.user.json, which OVERRIDES this key); an empty config still boots and the tools prompt for the path. Override hatch for a non-portable setup: set DataDir+ModsDir+ProfileDir explicitly instead (used only when no user-config and no Mo2InstanceDir). CorpusPath = houseCARL's own rulebook (absolute in dev; defaults beside the exe when packaged). Writes go to a NEW MO2 mod folder under the mods folder ('houseCARL - <name>'). MaxPlugins 0 = the whole order; cap it for a fast smoke build (e.g. --HouseCarl:MaxPlugins 300).
